title: Natural-Language Workflow Composer — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Lets users define multi-application workflows through conversational instructions. A proposed composer that builds workflows from conversation: the user describes a multi-application process in plain language, the composer drafts the workflow, the user refines it conversationally, and the result is a tested, runnable workflow with every step inspectable.
